body:
Real finding: kanban_cards is a single global hardcoded table, no board column, tied to one specific EMILY_BACKLOG_PATH file, single shared iduna.admin auth gate -- a real structural mismatch with IDUNA_PRO's own tenants who have no such file. 4 real open questions named. 4-phase plan: kanban_boards table + board_id, per-board auth, board management UI, conditional custom columns. No code changed -- planning only.

⚓ ☃
title: MULTIKANBAN-000: multi-kanban board scoped (Principle 19), not built
